properties.description: Deploys a diagnostic setting with the allLogs category group to the security workspace for the resource types in resourceTypeList. Decision SEC02. Every listed resource type requires a documented security use case (SEC01) and an entry in the routing inventory.

nonComplianceMessages.message: Diagnostic settings should be deployed to forward security logs to the security Log Analytics workspace.
